text: A fixed point x* of a 1D ODE dx/dt = f(x) is asymptotically stable if and only if:
explanation: f(x*) = 0 is necessary (but not sufficient) for x* to be a fixed point. Asymptotic stability requires small perturbations to decay, which by linearisation holds when f'(x*) < 0. When f'(x*) > 0 the point is unstable; when it equals 0 the linearisation is inconclusive.
